answer: Treat identity as a grafted grove, not a fence line. No new vine is admitted until two unrelated established plants graft it onto the rootstock, and each epoch a random panel re-inspects the graft. A key with a hollow history, no genuine prior work, cannot be grafted at all, and grafts whose timing correlates too tightly are collapsed into one stump with bonds slashed. So a sybil farm cannot sow M seeds: each needs two independent sponsors plus real history, and one correlation merges the cluster into a single vote. Cost: M independent sponsors and slashable bond capital, not M cheap keys.
